clips.title: The story
paras: At the Stonewrought Dam, Disarming Colloid could keep Seaforium from exploding when wet. Ashlan Stonesmirk provides it in the Wetlands for a mixture that can neutralize the powder.

Ashlan Stonesmirk recognized the powder left by Dark Iron sappers at the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan as Seaforium. Its scent and fine silver crystals gave it away. The powder is harmless while dry, but moisture makes it immensely destructive, a grave danger at the waterlogged dam. Stonesmirk provided Disarming Colloid to stop the reaction before detonation. Mixed with lurker venom, crushed Mo'grosh crystal, and a crocolisk tear, the colloid neutralizes Seaforium's explosive properties.
